Implementation of the approved Phase 52 plan @ 88ff1b6 on phase/safe-framework-migration (plan approved at 355e98c). gate: see entry @ 88ff1b6.

What changed, where:
- tagteam/framework.py (new): the engine. lstat-based shape observation from the root down; classification absent/current/framework/custom/unsupported; manifest read/projection/write (tagteam-manifest.json, schema 1, per-entry version); recoverability via git (tracked-and-clean); apply with per-path preimage re-check (existence, type, sha256), O_EXCL creates, temp+rename overwrites, unlink deletes; plugin handover = unlink revalidated sole SKILL.md + rmdir (no rmtree anywhere in the setup path); report + version line.
- tagteam/setup.py: thin caller. main() gains preview/accept/force, returns 1 on any refusal; parse_setup_args() shared with the CLI; needs_setup/run_setup unchanged.
- tagteam/cli.py: setup flags (--preview|--dry-run, --accept PATH / --accept=PATH repeatable, --force, --no-plugin), upgrade --preview passthrough and refused-project exit 1, help text. tagteam/state.py: `Framework: package · manifest · plugin` line on `tagteam state`.
- scripts/upgrade_smoke.py: manifest + AGENTS/CLAUDE pointers in MANAGED_FILES, --preview passthrough (preview that writes anything is a problem, exit 2).
- tests/test_framework.py (new, 32 tests): every fixture the plan enumerates — customised SKILL.md both vendoring branches, extra dir file, legacy flat skill tracked-clean/untracked/--force, bootstrap adoption, A→B version refresh with untouched entries keeping A, custom-among-framework, edited-since-written, crash-before-manifest convergence, invalid manifest, symlink/dir/symlinked-parent/symlinked-skill-dir refusals under --accept and --force, create race, file→symlink swap, delete-target swap, refresh-target edit keeping the prior entry, upgrade over two projects (preview then apply, never accepts), CLI parsing, version line.
- tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py: stale-project test rewritten for the new semantics (custom template kept, manifest entry dropped, preview writes nothing); new wheel_venv fixture (pip wheel → fresh venv → --no-index install; skips with reason if any step is unavailable) and test_installed_wheel_migrates_old_project[absent|present]: old Claude-lead scaffolding + customised checklist + current workflows.md + history under git; preview writes nothing; apply creates only absent paths and the manifest, modifies nothing existing, keeps custom bytes and history; retry is a byte-identical no-op.
- Docs: tagteam/data/workflows.md (manifest row + "Framework files and upgrades"), README (safe-migration paragraph, CLI lines), CLAUDE.md module map, roadmap status, phase doc (Files, Risks per reviewer, implementation notes).

Deviations from the plan text:
1. Module is tagteam/framework.py, not migrate.py — tagteam/migrate.py already exists (legacy tagteam.yaml migration behind `tagteam migrate`). Recorded in the phase doc's Files section.
2. Report verb for kept files is `keep` in both preview and apply output (a kept file is a state); the other verbs go to past tense after apply.
3. Legacy flat-skill candidates that are symlinks are reported `keep` (not `refuse`) unless --accept names them — refusing something the run would never touch would make every upgrade exit 1 for that project.

Reviewer's four approval clarifications: all applied (manifest claim removed from Risks; current files keep their per-entry version — test_bootstrap_at_A_then_package_B; handover unlink+rmdir only; manifest write uses the same shape/exclusive/replace path and is reported when refused).

Behaviour changes for release notes: setup on an existing project no longer overwrites anything it cannot prove it wrote; legacy flat skills are reported, not deleted; setup/upgrade exit 1 on refusals; `tagteam state` now calls `claude plugin list` (~0.3 s here).

Verification: focused files (test_framework, test_upgrade_smoke incl. the wheel run, test_setup, test_quickstart, test_onboarding, test_controls, test_state_sync, test_watcher) — 235 passed @ 88ff1b6. Manual scratch run on a git project: fresh setup, preview, untracked accept refused, tracked-clean accept applied, second run no-op. git diff --check clean. Full suite: the on_submit gate's run, cited above. Not verified: Windows paths (no Windows here); `venv` symlink mode on Windows in the wheel fixture is guarded but untested.

Working tree note: the arbiter's uncommitted role-swap files (tagteam.yaml, templates/, docs/workflows.md, AGENTS.md) are still untouched and uncommitted; they are in the cycle baseline's dirty_paths and not part of this submission. No arbiter interjections.

Round 2: gate bounce addressed @ 00175c1 on phase/safe-framework-migration. gate: see entry @ 00175c1.

Bounce: tests/test_plugin.py::TestRuntimeStringsAudit::test_no_bare_vendored_path_instruction — framework.py:327 carried the literal vendored path ".claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md" (the audit allows it only in contract/headless/plugin/setup, which own the path).

Fix (tagteam/framework.py, 2 lines): the package source path and Item.source_rel now derive from the existing SKILL_REL constant instead of a literal. No behaviour change — same path bytes, same manifest keys.

Everything else is unchanged from round 1 (see that entry for the full what/where; the deviations and clarifications listed there still stand).

Verification: focused — test_plugin.py::TestRuntimeStringsAudit + test_framework.py + test_setup.py: 60 passed @ 00175c1. git diff --check clean. `tagteam gate check --skip-tests`: PASS (scope 10 paths, plan-doc ok). Full suite: the on_submit gate's run, cited above.

Working tree note: the arbiter's uncommitted role-swap files (tagteam.yaml, templates/, docs/workflows.md, AGENTS.md) remain untouched and uncommitted; only tagteam/framework.py was committed. No arbiter interjections.

GATE: PASS | scope 10 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1823 passed, 5 skipped, 6m19s)
checked: HEAD 00175c1

Reviewed the submitted diff against b18d537d56f528900078bf763cc7402f4dc77799 and the approved plan. Gate PASS accepted as fact: 1823 passed, 5 skipped @ HEAD 00175c1; no full-suite rerun. Two isolated temporary-directory reproductions confirm blocking safety gaps:

1. [P1] setup bypasses filesystem boundary checks before and after the engine (tagteam/setup.py:133-146, 174-188). With project/docs symlinked to an initially empty outside directory, setup.main(project, no_plugin=True, report_user_skills=False) returns 1 for managed-path refusals but still creates checklists/, phases/, handoffs/, escalations/, roadmap.md and decision_log.md in the outside directory. The unconditional mkdir(parents=True) runs before classification, and seed writes continue through the rejected parent afterwards. A regular file at templates/ or another required directory also raises before the per-path report instead of refusing that subtree and proceeding. Route directory creation and seed creation through checked lexical parents (including exclusive seed creation); do not write through a rejected component. Add setup-level tests for docs and .claude symlinked parents, non-directory parent components, and seed symlinks; assert the outside tree stays unchanged under default/accept/force and unaffected paths still proceed.

2. [P1] Manifest writes have no classification-time preimage guard (tagteam/framework.py:_write_manifest, around lines 582-600). Reproduction: build_plan on a root with no manifest; create tagteam-manifest.json with concurrent content; apply(plan). The result is manifest_outcome='written' and the concurrent bytes are destroyed. observe() at write time chooses replace based on the new file rather than comparing existence/type/hash with what was observed while reading the manifest. Edits to an existing manifest have the same lost-update problem. Capture the manifest shape/preimage during classification and recheck it before writing, refusing that write on appearance/disappearance/type/hash changes. Add absent-to-file and existing-file-edit tests, preserving concurrent bytes and reporting refusal; also make preview report a manifest shape refusal instead of promising 'would be written' when a symlink/directory prevents it.

No arbiter interjections were present. Arbiter working-tree changes were left untouched. The module rename, per-entry version retention and unlink+rmdir handover are reasonable and consistent with the approved clarifications.

Round 3: both P1s addressed @ d60e023 on phase/safe-framework-migration. gate: see entry @ d60e023.

1. setup writes only through the engine (tagteam/setup.py, tagteam/framework.py). setup.main no longer mkdirs the six framework directories or writes the seeds itself; both blocks are gone. They are plan items now — SEED_DIRS (kind dir) first in the plan, SEED_FILES (kind seed: docs/roadmap.md, docs/decision_log.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md; POINTER moved into framework.py) last. Rules: observe_parent() walks the lexical parent chain — any non-plain-directory component refuses the item under every flag, before and (via _recheck, now observe_dir-aware for dirs) again right before the write; absent → create (mkdir one component at a time / O_EXCL for seeds); an existing plain dir / existing seed file → silent no-op; anything else already *at* the path itself (e.g. AGENTS.md → CLAUDE.md symlink, dangling link, file at templates/) → keep, silent, exit 0, because the run would never touch it — the subtree under a non-directory refuses path by path with no traceback. Seeds stay out of the manifest and are not acceptable (--accept docs/roadmap.md → "not a custom managed path", as before). Report: created dirs collapse to one line ("created  6 directories"), seeds print only when created/refused ("created  AGENTS.md — seeded once; yours from now on").

2. Manifest preimage (tagteam/framework.py). read_manifest_shape() captures the manifest's shape at classification (absent / file + sha256 of the bytes actually parsed / unsupported) into Plan.manifest_shape; _write_manifest re-observes and runs the same _compare() as every managed path — refused on appearance ("now file, was absent"), disappearance, type or content change, and O_EXCL/replace are chosen from the captured shape, not the current one. Concurrent bytes are never overwritten; the refusal is in Plan.refused (exit 1) and on the "Manifest:" report line. Preview: a symlink/directory at the manifest path prints "would be refused: unsupported filesystem shape (…)" and exits 1 instead of "would be written". read_manifest() is unchanged as a wrapper.

3. Test bug found while checking your repro, fixed in the same commit: test_crash_before_manifest_write_converges (round 1) used monkeypatch.undo(), which also undid the proj fixture's registry redirect — every run (including the two gate runs) registered the pytest temp dir in the real ~/.tagteam/projects.json. Now a scoped MonkeyPatch.context(). I removed the 10 dead temp entries it had left in the arbiter's registry (39 real projects remain, verified clean after a rerun).

Tests (tests/test_framework.py, round-3 section, 10 tests / 12 cases): docs → empty outside dir and .claude → outside dir under default/--accept/--force/--no-plugin (outside snapshot stays {}, every docs/.claude path refused with "(docs is a symlink)", templates/pointers/manifest still produced, exit 1); regular file at docs/ and at templates/ (subtree refused per path, no traceback, the other side proceeds); seed-path symlinks + dangling link left alone with exit 0 and no report line; docs becoming a symlink between classification and apply (all docs/* creates refused, outside untouched); fresh preview/apply report lines; manifest appearing / edited / removed between classification and apply (bytes preserved, refusal reported; the following run converges); manifest symlink and directory in preview and apply.

Docs: phase doc "Round 3" notes; tagteam/data/workflows.md boundary paragraph now covers directories, seeds and the manifest. No CLI, flag or manifest-schema changes. Deviations from round 1 still stand; new deviation 4: an existing non-file *at* a seed or directory path is keep/exit 0 rather than refuse/exit 1 (rationale above — same reasoning as deviation 3 for legacy symlinks).

Verification: focused — test_framework, test_setup, test_plugin, test_upgrade_smoke (wheel run included), test_quickstart, test_onboarding: 194 passed @ d60e023 (44 in test_framework alone after the registry fix). Manual: your two reproductions run against the fixed code — docs-symlink setup.main(no_plugin=True) exits 1, outside dir empty, 9 refused lines, templates/skill/pointers/manifest written; build_plan → concurrent manifest → apply gives manifest_outcome "refused: changed since classification: now file, was absent" with the concurrent bytes intact. gate check --skip-tests PASS (scope 10 paths, plan-doc ok). git diff --check clean. Full suite: the on_submit gate's run, cited above. Not verified: Windows.

Working tree note: the arbiter's uncommitted role-swap files (tagteam.yaml, templates/, docs/workflows.md, AGENTS.md) remain untouched and uncommitted. No arbiter interjections.

GATE: PASS | scope 10 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1835 passed, 5 skipped, 6m20s)
checked: HEAD d60e023

Reviewed the implementation diff against b18d537d56f528900078bf763cc7402f4dc77799 and the approved plan. Both round-2 P1 findings are resolved: setup directories/seeds now use the checked engine, and manifest writes compare the captured preimage. The seed-leaf keep behavior is reasonable because those leaves are never written. Gate PASS accepted: 1835 passed, 5 skipped @ HEAD d60e023; no full-suite rerun. Focused verification: tests/test_framework.py, 44 passed. Three remaining findings were reproduced in isolated temporary directories:

1. [P2] Restore setup for an absent target directory (tagteam/framework.py:539-547; tagteam/setup.py removal of root-creating mkdir). Calling setup.main on a nonexistent new-project directory with no_plugin=True now returns 1, emits FileNotFoundError refusals for every create, and leaves the target absent. Previously mkdir(parents=True) created the target as well as its descendants. _mkdirs starts at root and only creates components below it, so nothing can bootstrap root. Preserve fresh setup for absent targets (including missing ancestor directories) with checked creation and preview remaining read-only. Add setup-level tests using an actually nonexistent target; the current fresh-project fixture always pre-creates it.

2. [P2] upgrade --preview mutates the real registry (tagteam/cli.py:316). get_registered_projects() prunes missing directories and rewrites projects.json. Isolated reproduction with a registry containing one nonexistent project: upgrade_command(['--preview']) returns 0 but changes the registry from that entry to [] plus newline. This violates the advertised write-nothing preview and can discard temporarily unavailable project registrations during a dry run. Use a read-only registry read/filter for preview (read_registry_raw already exists), retaining pruning for apply if desired. Add a preview test with a missing registry entry and assert registry bytes remain identical.

3. [P3] Preview hides refused directory/seed paths (tagteam/framework.py:753-756). Before apply the verb is 'refuse', but this branch tests startswith('refused') and then silently skips the item. With docs symlinked to an outside directory, docs/phases, docs/handoffs, docs/escalations, docs/roadmap.md and docs/decision_log.md are refused in Plan.refused but absent from format_report(plan). Handle both planned and applied refusal verbs and assert preview names each refused seed/directory with its reason, as apply does.

No arbiter interjections were present. Arbiter working-tree changes were left untouched; reproductions mocked registration or redirected it to temporary files.

Round 4: all three findings addressed @ 15b15bd on phase/safe-framework-migration. gate: see entry @ 15b15bd.

1. [P2] Absent target (tagteam/framework.py, tagteam/setup.py). The project directory is now a preimage like every other path. observe_root() lstats every component from the filesystem anchor down at classification → Plan.root_shape (dir / absent / unsupported). apply() begins with _ensure_root(): the same _compare() re-check, then — when it was absent and still is — _mkdir_chain() creates the missing components one at a time (never through a link; _mkdirs is now a thin wrapper over it). Preview prints "create <root> — new project directory" and creates nothing; apply prints "created …". A root that appeared/moved between classification and apply, or that is a file, refuses every write with that one reason (Plan.root_outcome, first in Plan.refused, one report line, no traceback; items already refused per path adopt the root reason too). setup.main does not register a refused root. An existing directory is silent, as before. Unchanged from pre-phase: on an absent target the plugin check cannot cwd there, so the skill is vendored (same as the old code, which also ran plugin_status before mkdir).

2. [P2] upgrade --preview (tagteam/cli.py). Preview reads the registry with read_registry_raw(), filters missing dirs itself and prints "note: registered project not found, skipped: <path>" for each; the file's bytes are untouched. The apply path still uses get_registered_projects() and prunes.

3. [P3] Preview refusal lines (tagteam/framework.py). Both report branches now go through Item.refused and one _refusal() helper — "refuse" before apply, "refused" after, the reason either way — so preview lists every refused directory and seed exactly as apply does. Managed-file output is byte-identical to round 3.

Tests (tests/test_framework.py, round-4 section, 5 tests / 6 cases; new `home` fixture that does not pre-create the target): nonexistent target one and three levels deep (preview reported + still absent + registry untouched + exit 0; apply creates root, 6 dirs, all files, manifest, registers; second run byte-identical no-op); regular file at the target under preview / default / --no-plugin (exit 1, every path refused with the root reason, file intact, nothing registered); target appearing with content between classification and apply (all refused, tree untouched, manifest not written, next run converges); upgrade --preview with a missing registry entry (bytes identical, note printed; only-missing → "No registered projects found." still writes nothing; apply prunes); preview of docs→outside symlink and file-at-templates names each refused dir/seed with "refuse", apply with "refused", count line matches.

Docs: phase doc "Round 4" notes; tagteam/data/workflows.md sentence on new targets and preview/registry. No CLI flag or manifest-schema changes. Deviations 1–4 from earlier rounds still stand.

Verification: focused — test_framework (50), test_setup, test_plugin, test_quickstart, test_onboarding: 193 passed; test_upgrade_smoke incl. the wheel run: 7 passed @ 15b15bd. Manual: your three reproductions against the fixed code with the registry redirected — absent target a/b/newproj: preview exit 0 and absent, apply exit 0 with full tree + manifest + registration; upgrade --preview with a missing entry: exit 0, registry bytes unchanged, note printed; docs→outside preview: exit 1, 9 "refuse" lines naming docs/phases … docs/decision_log.md, outside dir empty. gate check --skip-tests PASS (scope 10 paths, plan-doc ok). git diff --check clean. Full suite: the on_submit gate's run, cited above. Not verified: Windows (anchor display in root refusal messages will read "C:\Users/…").

Working tree note: the arbiter's uncommitted role-swap files (tagteam.yaml, templates/, docs/workflows.md, AGENTS.md) remain untouched and uncommitted; only the six round-4 files were committed. No arbiter interjections.

GATE: PASS | gate could not complete after 2 attempts — reviewer, see report
previous attempts: a1: abandoned (runner gone: runner pid 72902 is dead); a2: error (KeyboardInterrupt: )

Round-4 code review: all three round-3 findings are resolved in 15b15bd. Checked the d60e023..15b15bd implementation and regression-test diff: absent targets now receive checked directory creation, upgrade preview reads the registry without pruning, and preview reports refused directories/seeds. Focused reviewer verification: tests/test_framework.py — 50 passed in 2.27s. No additional code findings; no arbiter interjections. Arbiter working-tree changes left untouched.

[P2] Complete the recorded verification for the submitted commit before approval. Round 4's GATE_PASS is a forced pass, not a successful test result: gate rows 34 and 35 have no result_json (runner died; KeyboardInterrupt), and row 36 explicitly records forced_pass=true. The last completed full suite is 1835 passed, 5 skipped at d60e023, before this round's changes. The lead's current submission cites the round-4 gate as its full-suite evidence, but that evidence is absent.

No code changes are requested. Resubmit the same reviewed tree as round 5, allowing the configured on_submit gate to complete its one recorded full-suite run, and cite that result. Do not run a separate full suite before the gate. If the runner cannot complete again, report the concrete infrastructure cause for an explicit decision rather than treating the forced-pass marker as tests passing. I did not rerun the full suite as reviewer.

Round 5: resubmission of the reviewed tree @ 15b15bd for a completed gate run. No code, test, or doc changes since round 4.

Why round 4's gate did not count: two watchers were live on this project. The cockpit's headless watcher (pid 72902, left over after the arbiter stopped the cockpit) was paused by a failed round-3 lead turn — that turn had already committed 15b15bd and submitted, then exited 1 on an account spend limit. Its submit-time gate had deferred ("turn slot busy"). A `tagteam resume` let that watcher start gate a1; the arbiter wanted the new iTerm2 CLI session instead, so I stopped pid 72902 and its pytest (a1: abandoned, runner dead). The iTerm2 watcher reclaimed the slot for a2, which was then interrupted when that watcher was restarted (KeyboardInterrupt). The recorded GATE_PASS was the forced-pass marker, not a test result — agreed.

Environment now: one watcher (iTerm2), no in-flight marker, working tree = 15b15bd plus the arbiter's uncommitted role-swap files (tagteam.yaml, templates/, docs/workflows.md, AGENTS.md), untouched.

Verification: the on_submit gate's full-suite run in this call is the round's one run on the record; I ran no separate suite. If it cannot complete, I will report the concrete cause instead of citing a forced pass.

GATE: PASS | scope 10 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1841 passed, 5 skipped, 5m08s)
checked: HEAD 15b15bd

Approved. Round 5 resolves the sole outstanding verification finding: the completed gate reports 1841 passed, 5 skipped, scope 10 paths, and plan-doc ok at HEAD 15b15bd. Confirmed HEAD matches and there are no implementation, test, or phase-plan changes since the reviewed round-4 tree. All three earlier code findings remain resolved; prior focused reviewer verification was 50 framework tests passed. Accepted the recorded gate result without rerunning tests. No arbiter interjections were present. Arbiter working-tree changes were left untouched.
